segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Iga mageuzi kwa kutumia viumbe vinavyotafuta chakula, vinavyozaana na kupitisha jeni zinazoweza kubadilika. Chunguza kila kiumbe, na uchanganue idadi ya viumbe na mgawanyo wa jeni kwa kutumia chati.
